scripts.build:installer: node scripts/run-with-rust.mjs tauri build --bundles msi --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json && node scripts/run-with-rust.mjs tauri build --bundles nsis --config apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && node scripts/run-with-rust.mjs cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.test: corepack pnpm -r --if-present test && node scripts/run-with-rust.mjs cargo test --workspace
scripts.contracts:generate: node scripts/run-with-rust.mjs cargo run -p hachimi-protocol --bin export-types -- packages/contracts/src/generated.ts
scripts.contracts:check: node scripts/run-with-rust.mjs cargo run -p hachimi-protocol --bin export-types -- packages/contracts/src/generated.ts --check
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm contracts:check && corepack pnpm storybook:build && corepack pnpm build
